integrity: Exact four-phase probability law follows from a torus Haar factorization and conditional arcsine density; a local expansion proves the logarithmic boundary coefficient. Checker provides reproducibility, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exactly four independent continuous Haar phases; the formula has no established extension here to other sequence lengths, finite phase alphabets or correlated chips. Analytic proof supplied; numerical checks are auxiliary. Historical novelty remains best-knowledge, not independently certified.
title: Exact peak-sidelobe distribution and a logarithmic Barker boundary for four random Fourier phases
